name: campusconnect
description: College-only peer help platform — matches students to helpers by academic relevance, not popularity

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install --omit=dev && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
